name: Sweden
note: Families do not register deaths in Sweden. The doctor who establishes death is responsible for a death certificate that the care institution or doctor sends to the Tax Agency (Skatteverket) by the next working day. Skatteverket is both registrar and keeper of the population register, so the deceased is deregistered at once. Other agencies receive the change electronically, and private bodies see it through SPAR, the state personal address register. A separate cause-of-death certificate goes to the National Board of Health and Welfare within three weeks.

citations.cite: Lag (1987:269) om kriterier för bestämmande av människans död, 2 §
citations.title: Fastställande av döden
citations.quote: Det ankommer på läkare att i överensstämmelse med vetenskap och beprövad erfarenhet fastställa att döden har inträtt.

citations.title: Dödsbevis och intyg om dödsorsaken
citations.quote: Vid dödsfall i Sverige skall bevis om dödsfallet (dödsbevis) och intyg om dödsorsaken utfärdas utan dröjsmål.

citations.title: Dödsbeviset lämnas till Skatteverket
citations.quote: Om något annat inte följer av 4 § skall dödsbeviset utan dröjsmål lämnas till Skatteverket.

citations.title: Vem som lämnar dödsbeviset
citations.quote: Om den avlidne vid dödsfallet vårdades på en sjukvårdsinrättning eller fördes dit i anslutning till dödsfallet, skall dödsbeviset lämnas av inrättningen.

citations.title: Anmälan till Polismyndigheten
citations.quote: ska den läkare som fastställt att döden har inträtt eller som i annat fall ska utfärda dödsbeviset snarast möjligt anmäla dödsfallet till Polismyndigheten

citations.title: Polismyndigheten underrättar Skatteverket
citations.quote: Polismyndigheten ska underrätta Skatteverket om dödsfallet och efter den utredning som kan behövas lämna dödsbeviset till Skatteverket

citations.title: Intyg för gravsättning eller kremering
citations.quote: Skatteverket ska utfärda ett intyg om att stoft får gravsättas eller kremeras.

citations.title: Tiden för kremering och gravsättning
citations.quote: ska kremeras eller gravsättas snarast möjligt och senast en månad efter dödsfallet.

citations.title: Dödsbevis
citations.quote: Beviset skall lämnas senast första vardagen efter det att dödsfallet konstaterades.

citations.title: Intyg om dödsorsaken
citations.quote: Intyget skall sändas till Socialstyrelsen inom tre veckor från det att dödsbeviset utfärdades.

citations.title: Skatteverkets uppgifter till Socialstyrelsen
citations.quote: Skatteverket skall lämna de uppgifter som Socialstyrelsen behöver

citations.title: Inledande bestämmelser
citations.quote: Skatteverket ansvarar för folkbokföring och sådan registrering som avses i andra stycket.

citations.title: Avregistrering från folkbokföringen
citations.quote: Den som avlider eller dödförklaras skall avregistreras från folkbokföringen.

citations.title: Lagens tillämpningsområde
citations.quote: framställning av personbevis och andra registerutdrag

citations.title: Ändamål (uppgiftslämnande)
citations.quote: Personuppgifter som behandlas enligt 5 § får också behandlas för att fullgöra uppgiftslämnande som sker i överensstämmelse med lag eller förordning.

citations.title: Elektroniskt utlämnande av personuppgifter
citations.quote: Personuppgifter får lämnas ut elektroniskt om det inte är olämpligt.

citations.title: Ikraftträdande och upphävande
citations.quote: Genom lagen upphävs lagen (2001:182) om behandling av personuppgifter i Skatteverkets folkbokföringsverksamhet.

citations.title: Statens personadressregister (SPAR)
citations.quote: Registret får användas av myndigheter och enskilda.

steps.title: A doctor establishes that death has occurred
steps.who: A doctor. The doctor who establishes death is responsible for the death certificate (dödsbevis) being issued.
steps.summary: Only a doctor may establish death, under the brain-death criteria of the 1987 Act; that doctor then answers for the dödsbevis reaching the Tax Agency.

steps.title: Possible forensic cases are reported to the police instead
steps.who: The doctor who established death or who is to issue the dödsbevis.
steps.trigger: Circumstances suggesting a forensic post-mortem may be needed.
steps.summary: The doctor reports the death to the Police Authority and sends the dödsbevis there rather than to the Tax Agency.

steps.title: Police tell the Tax Agency and forward the dödsbevis with burial clearance
steps.summary: The police notify Skatteverket of the death and, after any investigation, send it the dödsbevis with permission for burial or cremation.

steps.title: Death certificate (dödsbevis) goes to the Tax Agency by the next working day
steps.who: The care institution where the deceased was being treated or was taken; otherwise the doctor who issued it. Skatteverket is the registrar.

deadline.text: no later than the first working day after the death was established

steps.summary: The death certificate must be issued and sent to Skatteverket without delay. Families have no registration duty.

steps.title: Cause-of-death certificate goes to the National Board of Health and Welfare
steps.who: The doctor who issued the dödsbevis (or the treating doctor on request); the institution sends it if the deceased was in its care; after a forensic post-mortem, the National Board of Forensic Medicine.

deadline.text: within three weeks of the dödsbevis

steps.summary: The cause-of-death certificate goes to Socialstyrelsen, which keeps the cause-of-death register; lateness must be explained in writing.

steps.title: Tax Agency issues the certificate allowing burial or cremation
steps.trigger: A dödsbevis showing no reason for a forensic examination, or police permission.

deadline.text: burial or cremation within one month of the death unless deferred

steps.summary: Burial or cremation needs Skatteverket's certificate, which issues only if the dödsbevis rules out a forensic case or the police have given permission.

steps.title: The deceased is deregistered from the population register
steps.who: Skatteverket, which is both the death registrar and the keeper of the population register (folkbokföringen).
steps.summary: Anyone who dies is deregistered from folkbokföringen; deaths are also registered for people who were never registered as residents.

steps.title: Extracts from the population register prove the death
steps.who: Skatteverket, to anyone requesting, subject to a secrecy test.
steps.summary: Population-register data are public records: secrecy applies only where there is particular reason to think disclosure would harm the person or a relative.

steps.title: Other agencies receive population-register changes electronically
steps.who: Skatteverket, to agencies with a legal basis, such as Försäkringskassan and Pensionsmyndigheten.
steps.summary: Since 2 April 2026 the new Population Data Act lets Skatteverket disclose data electronically and to meet statutory reporting duties. The recipient agencies' own provisions and the distribution service (Navet) were not read.

steps.title: Tax Agency gives the National Board of Health and Welfare the data to chase missing certificates
steps.summary: Skatteverket supplies what Socialstyrelsen needs to tell the responsible doctor to send in an overdue cause-of-death certificate.

steps.title: SPAR gives private bodies the date of deregistration on death
steps.who: Authorities and private parties using SPAR to update and check personal data; data come from the population database.
steps.summary: SPAR holds the deregistration and its date and may be used by authorities and private parties to update, complete and check personal data.

registrationDeadlineDays.note: The dödsbevis must reach Skatteverket by the first working day after the death was established; families have no duty.

informantDuty.note: The care institution submits the dödsbevis if the deceased was in its care; otherwise the doctor. The doctor who established death is responsible.

medicalExaminerScrutiny.note: No independent review of every certificate: Socialstyrelsen receives cause certificates and chases late ones; forensic cases go to the police.

electronicRegistration.note: The Acts read do not say whether the dödsbevis must be sent electronically; Skatteverket guidance could not be reached.

governmentPropagation.note: The registrar is the population register, so registration is deregistration; other agencies receive the change electronically. The Population Data Act (2026:126) replaced the 2001 Act on 2 April 2026.

certificateAccess.note: Population-register data are public subject to a secrecy test that applies only for particular reason; Skatteverket issues personbevis and extracts.

privateSectorVerification.note: SPAR carries deregistration on death with its date and is open to private bodies for updating and checking personal data.

gaps: Lag (2001:182) and förordning (2001:589) on population-register data were repealed on 2 April 2026 by folkbokföringsdatalag (2026:126) and förordning (2026:157). The new förordning no longer lists recipients (the old 15 a § named banks, insurers and funeral firms acting for an estate). Where those disclosures now rest was not established.
The legal basis for Försäkringskassan, Pensionsmyndigheten and SCB receiving deaths automatically (Navet) was not read; se-agencies is marked unverified.
Whether the dödsbevis must be submitted electronically was not found in the Acts; Skatteverket guidance was unreachable.
The brief cites Lag (1972:1157) for the criteria of death; the Act in force on riksdagen.se is Lag (1987:269), which is cited instead.
